Sure! Here's my answer based on the given passages:

To check if taxes were filed, you can follow these methods:

1. Check online: You can use your mobile phone to check the status of a tax return using the IRS2Go application available on the Apple App Store. You can also check the status online through the IRS website. To do this, you will need your Social Security number, tax filing status, and the amount of any refund due.
2. Check by phone: You can call the IRS at 1-800-829-1954 to check the status of your tax return. Make sure to have your Social Security number and tax filing status ready.
3. Check through tax software: If you used tax software to prepare and file your taxes, you can check the status of your return through the software's application. Most tax software programs will send you an email confirmation when the IRS accepts your tax return.

Please note that it takes time for the IRS to process tax returns, so it's important to give them adequate time before checking on the status of your refund. If you e-filed your taxes, you should be able to get a refund status within 72 hours. If you mailed your taxes, you will have to wait 3 or 4 weeks after mailing in your taxes.
